name: crypto-bitcoin-201601
description: Nodes represent Bitcoin addresses. Each hyperedge represents a transaction and contains the set of addresses involved in that transaction. This dataset contains the first 1.5M Bitcoin transactions of Jan. 2016.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., crypto-bitcoin-201601).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.address: (STRING) Bitcoin wallet address represented by the node (e.g., 1EQbqKSeAt7ev66owPpBnubk5LBDDjh299).
